text:
Rohit CSM: Heads-up: Eastwood EBR next Thurs 11am ET. Need a single-slide playbook (flow + 3 bullets) and a live action ticker for post-meeting ops. Slides in drive at ~v0.5.
Olivia SE: I can handle the demo. Proposal: 1 main flow + 1 micro-fallback (cold cache). Keep each demo <=4m.
Marcus AM: We also need a one-paragraph renewal-risk blurb for the exec slide. Health dipped 6% after onboarding delays. Can someone pull ticket reasons?
Tess Enablement: I'll build the action tracker and capture enablement asks. Planning a 20-min dry run Wed to walk handoffs. Will assign owners in the sheet.
deckbot: New upload: https://drive.redwood.com/eastwood/ebr_slide_v0.5  comments on slides 1-3.
Rohit CSM: Olivia, add a note: "Fallback: switch to quantized model if p95 > 300ms." Keep it one line in notes.
Olivia SE: ack. I'll add runbook steps and an offline GIF in case streaming fails.
Marcus AM: Quick risk breakdown I see: (1) onboarding backlog, (2) SLA gap on ingest, (3) billing dispute. I'll draft mitigations and paste a 2-line exec blurb.
Tess Enablement: Ticker template: `Owner | Task | Due | Priority | Status | Confidence`. Make it editable for owners, view-only for execs.
Rohit CSM: Add a "Follow-up owner" column too. Also, slide polish deadline Tue 9am ET and dry run Wed 11am ET. Call out conflicts now.
Marcus AM: I may miss Wed dry run slot 11am ET 1 have another customer. I'll record a short voice blurb for my exec line.
Olivia SE: I'll bring the laptop with local fallbacks and a 60s offline demo ready.
Tess Enablement: Live ticker link: https://sheets.redwood.com/eastwood-ebr-actions  starting to populate rows and ping owners.
Rohit CSM: Great. After rehearsal we'll triage follow-ups by priority and set SLAs for each action. Thanks team :rocket:
